summary: The fund seeks to track the investment results of the S&P Global Timber & Forestry IndexTM (the “underlying index”), which measures the performance of companies engaged in the ownership, management or upstream supply chain of forests and timberlands from both developed and emerging markets. underlying index constituents are drawn from the S&P Global BMI. The fund is non-diversified.
